articleTitle: The Introduction of Artificial Intelligence in the Study of Economic Disciplines in Higher Educational Institutions
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article reveals the importance of teaching artificial intelligence and its application in the study of economic disciplines in higher educational institutions. The article reveals the importance of teaching logical programming languages, including the PROLOG language. The novelty of the article lies in the use of simple spreadsheet editors as prototypes of expert systems, as well as building predictive models using the STATISTICA program. Thanks to such software, it is possible to achieve model accuracy in forecasting, building regression analysis, tending to one hundred percent.

Author Keywords: foreign experience in introducing artificial intelligence into education

articleTitle: Digital Teaching Assistant for the Python Programming Course
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The digitalization of modern economic sectors leads to the lack of software developers in many industries. Hence, there is the increasing demand for mass training of IT specialists in colleges and universities. With the increasing students count, the workload for teachers of disciplines connected with IT tremendously increases. The automation of software developers training allows to reduce the burden on teachers by saving them from routine work. In this paper, we provide the details regarding the development of the Digital Teaching Assistant (DTA), the information system used in Federal State Budget Educational Institution of Higher Education “MIREA – Russian Technological University”, integrated into the Python programming course. The considered system consists of two components, namely, the DTA core, and the DTA web application, both components are implemented using the Python programming language. The DTA core generates tasks and tests for students, and the DTA web application allows students to interact with the core. We describe the architecture of DTA and visualize the statistics collected during system operation.

articleTitle: Quasi-Cryptographic Methods in the Management of Educational Tasks
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: A method of organizing the educational process and knowledge control in large groups of students by issuing assignments from a large (almost unlimited) sample of options is proposed. The method of generating variants based on the last name, first name, patronymic of the student is shown. It is shown that a suitable sample of variants should be at least the square of the size of the stream/group. The possibility of accelerated verification of tasks with the help of functional connections in the space of answers, i.e., peculiar keys known to the teacher, is demonstrated. Separate examples of tasks important both in the methodological aspect and in terms of application in the spectrum of disciplines of the departments of applied mathematics are given.

articleTitle: Practical Aspects of VR-technology Usage for Industry-based NDT Specialists Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the problem of practical application of software solutions based on virtual reality technology in training, retraining and advanced training of industry specialists in nondestructive testing. The comprehensive multi-component approach to the creation of the training environment proposed by NIKIMT-Atomstroy experts is presented. The main components, their goals and tasks are considered. Course structure, lesson plan and illustrations of training process in virtual environment are given. The main directions of solution development and scaling are listed.

articleTitle: Smart Educational Robotics Laboratory Ecosystem for Remote Control of Robotic Manipulators Through Telepresence Technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper discusses a smart laboratory robotics system designed to allow students remote connection and work with robotic manipulation devices and applications, as well as for teaching and conducting collaborative research projects in the field of electrical engineering and automation. A scheme of connecting all the necessary robotic devices and video cameras to the main server in the laboratory for the possibility of connecting to a remote desktop is presented. The developed solution for remotely connecting students to a physical robotic cell, which is connected to the lab server, is presented. Thanks to the proposed system, it was possible to conduct a debugging of new solutions for the control of robotic manipulation systems on a particular connected technological equipment. A telepresence system with real-time video streaming of physical robotic cell was developed to monitor the behavior of the robotic system remotely in order to understand the process of the connected devices clearly after the solution was uploaded to the robot controller.

articleTitle: Hardware and Software Development of the System for Photogrammetry of Small Objects
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article presents the process of developing hardware and software modules that implement the method of spatial scanning the small objects. Previously, drawings and volumetric model of the rotary table of the automated system were developed. The main body components were printed using a 3D printer based on additive manufacturing technology. The software module is implemented using the Processing and C++ programming languages. With the help of the developed system, it is possible to create the initial geometry for numerical analysis problems. As an example, a 3D model of an object with complex spatial geometry is built. In addition, a photogrammetric system can be successfully introduced into the educational process.

articleTitle: Chatbot to Increase the Effectiveness of the «Flipped Classroom» Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Many researchers believe that one of the most effective educational technologies is the «Flipped classroom». To evaluate the effectiveness of the «Flipped classroom» technology, own research was conducted. The research showed that there is a problem working with the material in non-auditorium conditions and some problems can be solved with the use of appropriate information technology. The work aims to develop a chatbot to increase the efficiency of the «Flipped classroom». The chatbot for Telegram was created. The chatbot, based on information from the database, conducts a dialogue with each student, periodically reminds him of the need to read the material, displays material and links to it, evaluates work with the material, issues test, and control questions to assess the comprehensibility of the material, saves work results, questions to the teacher in the database. Using the chatbot is aimed at increasing the student s involvement in the process of home preparation for the seminar. The data collected during the work with the bot, material, testing results, questions will allow the teacher to conclude that the students of the group are ready for the lesson. Due to the chatbot, the efficiency of «Flipped classroom» technology will increase.

articleTitle: Information and Educational Environment in the Inclusive Education Practice
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The study is devoted to inclusive education. The role and importance of the information and educational environment in the practice of inclusive education are discussed. The characteristics of the information and educational environment of the university are given. This paper provides data on the analysis of the main components of inclusive education. A functioning model of the information and educational environment of the university for people with disabilities is presented.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of the «Smart Greenhouse» Project in the Educational Process of an Educational Institution
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article reveals the use of smart technologies in the educational process of educational institutions, discusses the development and implementation of the project “smart greenhouse”. The technology of developing a “smart greenhouse” is shown, which consists of studying the capabilities of a “smart greenhouse” from the standpoint of resource conservation, studying the functions of the components of a “smart greenhouse” regarding the conditions necessary for seed germination and plant cultivation, developing software for controlling the greenhouse microclimate, creating an experimental sample of a “Smart greenhouse” with specified conditions in full size. The application of a smart greenhouse is described within the framework of various subjects, sections, topics and various types of scheduled and extracurricular activities. It is important to develop and implement research projects using an experimental sample of a “smart greenhouse” in the educational process of an educational institution.

articleTitle: National Identity as a Factor in the Upbringing and Education of Young People
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article analyzes the role of national identity in the process of upbringing and education of young people. In modern conditions, this problem seems important and in demand. Steady globalization blurs the boundaries between states, promoting economic, political and cultural integration. But, at the same time, globalization, blurring cultural boundaries, leads to a crisis of identities. In such conditions, social practice undergoes serious transformations. Higher education is one of the most important components of social practice. Therefore, the question regarding factors affecting the specifics of higher education really seems relevant.

articleTitle: Some Innovations in a Short Course of Discrete Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose to systematically use two-dimensional induction when presenting combinatorics in a short course in discrete mathematics, which makes it easy and from a unified standpoint to consider all combinatorial numbers, in particular, Stirling numbers, Lah numbers, Catalan numbers.

articleTitle: Statistical Methods for Extracting Collocations from a Text Corpus
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with statistical methods for extracting collocations on the example of the English Web 2020 corpus (enTenTen20). The authors considered three types of association measures: t-score, MI-score and Log Dice, which determine the strength of association between collocates based on the frequencies of their own and joint occurrence in the corpus. The importance of corpus linguistics technology in the study of various language aspects is especially emphasized.

articleTitle: Management of Ungraded Educational Organizations in the Digital Transformation of Education
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This research discusses the problems of managing ungraded educational organizations (UEOs) integrated into a digital learning environment (DLE). The educational and managerial aspects of this environment are examined. One of the critical challenges addressed in this environment is the sustainability of the educational system of the UEO, which is highly susceptible to a variety of external influences, including in the management process. The research proposes to consider the region’s UEOs in the information nexus that forms a unified digital educational environment. The stability of this environment can be assessed using system criteria. One of the critical tasks to be solved within the DLE of the system of UEOs is the organization of the communication system to optimize the document flow of the UEO.

articleTitle: Regulatory and Methodological Support for the Mixed Reality Technology in Education
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article analyzes the possibilities of using the mixed reality technology in education. The authors review the literature on the augmented reality technologies that can provide benefits compared to other technical solutions used in education at the moment.

articleTitle: Features of Continuous Education of the Adult Population
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the issues of continuing education of the adult population. The analysis of statistical data on continuous education of the adult population in Russia and abroad is carried out. The main trends in obtaining continuous education of the adult population have been identified.

articleTitle: Laboratory Installation to Demonstrate the Advantages of a DC Network in a Smart Home
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article analyzes the power supply system of a Smart Home based on a DC network. The question of the relevance of this technology, as well as the advantages of the system is considered. The load of a private house is determined by calculation method and the proof of effective integration of DC network into the energy structure of a residential building is provided. By the example of a laboratory installation the significance of the generator-storage-inverter-consumer system is demonstrated during the transition of some household appliances to direct current supply. The possibilities and prospects of implementing a laboratory model of smart home for training are analyzed, and algorithms for the control and interaction of devices are described.

articleTitle: Computer Modeling, Simulation and Visualization in Teaching Probability to Mathematics Students
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The purpose of the study is to identify and justify the main directions for improving the professional training of mathematics students in the context of informatization and digitalization. The article also considers examples of applying the obtained theoretical conclusions in the study of probability theory. The proposed lab provides an example of the application of information and communication technologies (ICT) for modeling and visualization to help students understand the basic concepts of probability theory. The authors conclude that there is a need for a consistent, expedient combination of traditional educational technologies and ICT in the educational process.

articleTitle: Best Practices in Teaching Foreign Students by Means of Creating Digital Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the processes of teaching foreign students in the digital environment. Special attention is given to the experience of Lipetsk State Technical University in developing educational programs for international students using digital technologies.

articleTitle: Identification of Relevant Scientific Articles using a Modified Naive Bayes Classifier
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The rapid growth in the number of scientific publications increases researchers’ need for systems that provide quick access to the most relevant articles on their subjects of interest. Existing solutions do not have enough flexibility to adapt to the needs of each user of the system. This study presents a scientific articles recommendation mechanism which takes into account the user’s individual preferences. The precision of the recommendations is 70%.

articleTitle: Formation of Digital Competencies for Scientific and Educational Activities of Students
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the problem of formation of digital competencies of higher education students, some of them determining the effectiveness of the organization of digital learning. The emphasis is placed on the project form of learning as one of the leading educational technologies for training modern specialists who meet the requirements of the digital economy. Particular attention is paid to the formation of interdisciplinary abilities and skills to conduct project activities as one of the basic competencies of a modern graduate.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Network Gait Recognition in Habitoscopy Learning Process
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article proposes a new method for human gaits classification. Deep neural networks were used to classify gait features. The public database CASIA Gait Dataset B were used for testing. The proposed method achieved the best rank-l identification rate of 83.78%, and rank-5–98.65%. This method can used for studying habitoscopy by students.

articleTitle: IoT System for Effective E²Learning Process. Test Results
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Effective $E_{Learning}^{2}$ system allow to increase the efficiency of studying up to 20% and more. During the video lesson the IoT devices with using AI are monitoring the level of the brain activity and sending the feedback to the software program. Digital image and video stream are modulated with the signals which switch the brain into the active state. At the periods of tiredness or/and the important moments of the lecture course these signals are keeping the brain in active state and allow to increase the efficiency of memorisation and boost up the overall learning process.

articleTitle: Organization of Joint Work on IT Projects in the Context of Distance Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Project activity for IT specialists in the field of academic formation reflects modern requirements of both professional and universal competencies. The transition to a distance learning format set forth the need to change the methodology for organizing work on IT projects and the use of digital technology tools. This paper presents the intricacies of joint work on IT projects in the conditions of team distributed development, as well as online services for the implementation of all development life cycle stages.

articleTitle: Digitalization of the Education System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article prepared for publication contains material on digitalization that is an integral part of the life of modern society, providing acceleration of economic processes and saving time and resources in almost all sectors of the economy, including education as the fundamental basis of human development. The purpose of the study is to provide in-depth justification of the prospects of digital technologies in the educational process for its qualitative improvement and subsequent growth of labor productivity and strengthening of national economic potential. Its achievement is focused on revealing the place and role of digitalization for education and substantiating the needs of relevant institutions in it with an emphasis on the pandemic period. The solution of the formulated tasks is carried out by using monographic and dialectical methods that help to systematize and improve the accumulated knowledge about education and the scientific and technical achievements used in it on the basis of the identified advantages and interpretation of their semantic content. These advantages are driving factors in the development of educational processes. The material presented in the article is useful for managers, specialists involved in the development of educational processes, as well as teachers of pedagogical directions.

articleTitle: Detection of Fake Educational Sites Using Fuzzy String Match
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The analysis of scientific paper and Internet sources devoted to the problem of information counteraction to threats of phishing sites of organizations is carried out. The need for the use of protective equipment on the side of organizations is shown. The relevance of the research topic is confirmed by the presence in the RU zone registry of domain names similar in spelling to well-known educational resources. A method for detecting fake websites based on checking the visual similarity of domain names is proposed. The developed method is based on the use of the Levenshtein metric used in the problem of fuzzy string comparison. The proposed method was tested on the dataset of domain names from the RU zone registry for a certain period of time. When implementing the fake site detection method, the Java programming language and the JGraphT library were used. The test results show an improvement in the quality of the search for domain names similar in spelling to the specified domain name of a web resource. The proposed method can be used in the implementation of one of the modules of a software tool for countering the threats of fake educational sites.

articleTitle: Polymodal Neighborhood Systems in System Modeling Course
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In teaching a course of mathematical modeling, it is useful to pay attention to problems in which the specificity of distributed or neighborhood systems is manifested in one way or another. One of these tasks is the task of managing a complex distributed process or object, consisting of a certain number of production nodes and connections, and having several nominal modes of operation. In this case, it is desirable that the corresponding mathematical model be polymodal, i.e., describe all nominal modes and switchings as local modes of the neighborhood system with transitions between them. Each local mode of the system as a whole corresponds to a certain set of microlocal modes of the nodes of the neighborhood structure that models the distributed object. As a rule, not all sets of microlocal modes are realized as some local mode. In this article, we describe two schemes for constructing a polymodal neighborhood system: based on local modes of the system as a whole and based on microlocal modes of nodes, without identifying the local modes of the entire system. The second scheme can be used to synthesize a polymodal neighborhood system from existing polymodal subsystems for nodes.

articleTitle: Current Issues of Legal Transformation of Educational Systems in Russia in the Context of Digitalization
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article describes the relevance of the application of various models in the educational process in higher education in Russia today and in the near future. The problems are presented in the dynamics of the development of the situation in the world, law and economics. The stages of the transition of Russian education to the Bologna system are studied in detail. Positive and negative aspects of the practice of its application. What are the advantages of returning to the traditional Russian specialty. The results of the work are shown. Conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: Using Mobile Devices to Realize Blended Learning at the University
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Currently, blended learning is becoming a promising form of organization of higher education. Use of smartphones and other mobile devices for the realization of blended learning makes it possible to provide students with equal access to educational and methodological content, that is, the conditions for reducing the information inequality of students. In this regard, the article reveals the structure of the activities of a teacher and a student in the process of mobile learning in the context of the realization of blended learning. The novelty of the research is determined by the fact that the structure and main content of the advanced refresher course “Blended learning at the university as a means of improving the quality of education in the context of the spread of coronavirus infection” are formulated. The practical significance of the study is determined by the fact that it shows the experience of organizing teacher training in an online format based on the platform ocs.wkau.kz.

articleTitle: Gesture Recognizing Technology Development for Interaction with Mobile Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article presents the implementation of gesture recognizing technology for interaction with mobile devices, describes approaches to the design of the user interface and approaches to the implementation of gesture recognizing technology. The software implementation of the palm recognizing function and an example of a developed software product for interacting with mobile devices through gesture recognizing are considered in detail.

articleTitle: The Ability to Control the Technical Vision of Robots for Effective Object Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The theoretical and practical issues of the development of a control system for the technical vision of robots, which is based on the specifics of the processed information and the principles of building an integral system for understanding the image of the scene in its study, as well as the principles of building an integral system for recognizing the image of the scene, are considered. The issues of visual representation of objects and processes on rectangular, triangular and hexagonal rasters are considered. The results of these studies make it possible to analyze data presented through visual coding, intelligent processing and use for support and decision-making systems in a wide variety of fields of knowledge. The use of the proposed approach to the description of objects provides rapid analysis of raster images, prepares the initial information for more subtle studies, allows to quickly determine the important characteristics of the object in the image.

articleTitle: Digitalization of Education and Private Law Issues of Investment in Construction in the Context of Economic Sanctions
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to study the existing legislative framework on the regulation of the investment and construction sector in modern Russia, under the economic sanctions of the West. The object of the study is regulated by civil, investment, land, urban planning, financial legislation, arising legal relations between subjects of investment and construction activities, including foreign residents. The subject of the study is the legal regulation of investment and construction activities in Russia. The following research methods are used in the article: theoretical analysis, generalization, abstraction, formal legal and comparative legal analysis of the scientific base on the topic under study and regulatory legal acts regulating the rights of subjects of investment and construction legal relations. The results of the study are the determination by its authors of the determinants of the destruction of the nature of the legal obligation. The main conclusions of the study are that the welfare state is a jurisdictionally separate legal space of rights and obligations, which has become more relevant in the context of digitalization in all areas of economics and law. In this study, we come to the conclusions: 1. The overload of the regulatory framework with legislative acts is obvious; 2. There is no mechanism for regulating the use of regulatory legal acts in the event of investment and construction relations; 3. A codified legal document (code) is required, which will minimize the amount of regulatory framework for the studied group of legal relations and establish rules of procedural tools that allow replacing declarations with mandatory norms of direct.

articleTitle: Methodological Aspects in the Practice of Advanced Training of Repair Personnel of Metallurgical Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Methodological foundations for the implementation of staff development programs using the competency-based approach are presented. Scenarios of distance and mixed learning are proposed.

articleTitle: Mastering Hybrid Roof Structures via Students’ Research Activity
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Hybrid roofs have advantages over ordinary building constructions. They are promising from the architectural point of view and comprise recyclable materials thus complying with the concept of sustainable development of the modern society. Hybrid roofs are, however, sophisticated building constructions which require competent specialists to bring them to life.The present paper illustrates the problem-based strategy for mastering the hybrid roofs. The whole roof system is split into the main cable structure and supporting structures which can be improved and investigated separately. Flexible and rigid supporting structures are considered and analyzed. It allows raising the problems of high deformability of the roof and undesirable partitioning of the internal space of the building, as well as the problem of large horizontal forces (the thrust) induced by vertical external loads. The main cable structure is adopted in the form of a ‘tensegrity’-system, which primarily consists of continuous flexible elements. Different embodiments are considered in order to illustrate the process of continuous structural enhancement.

articleTitle: Development of Foreign Language Competence of Students at Technical Universities
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The development of foreign language competence of students at Technical universities is presented in the research work. The focus is given on the individual variable character of distance foreign language learning program.

Author Keywords: individual approach to foreign language learning

articleTitle: Implementation of Educational Programs in the Field of Training IT Specialists on the Orders of Companies
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper gives the description of the program of additional education for students in the field of information technology, implemented by the university in collaboration with IT companies. The following prerequisites for the development of such educational programs are noted: trends in the information technology market and the growing demand for qualified specialists. The needs of organizations in competencies of their employee lead to a personalized additional educational program for students developed by the university for the company. The conclusion of agreements between the student, the company and the university allows guaranteeing students - additional scholarships and employment, companies - reducing the adaptation time for new employees due to the availability of relevant competencies and getting to know the company in the learning process, the university - additional funding and developing the competencies of university teachers. An example of such a program implemented by the Lipetsk State Technical University in collaboration with RetailDriver LLC for students educated on Bachelor's programs in IT areas is given.

articleTitle: Development of a Learning Process Management System Using the Prism Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the informatization of the educational process. At the beginning, a visual model of the learning process is built, its “bottlenecks” are determined. To eliminate them, a e-learning system is being developed. This training system is built on the basis of “client-server” technology using the microservice architecture of the Prism framework and the C Sharp programming language.

articleTitle: Designing a Digital Educational Service Based on Didactic Tasks
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The development of software products for the education sector is characterized by specific results requirements. Digital services for education are subject to special requirements both from society and legislation, and from participants in educational relations. Introduction of new digital technologies in the educational process should not be the aim itself. The use of digital educational resources and services should contribute to the achievement of didactic and educational tasks. When designing educational software products, it is, first of all, necessary to consider the didactic tasks that the teacher pursues in his/her work. This article proposes an approach to the development of an educational web service based on the selection of software solutions for the didactic tasks to be solved.

articleTitle: Formation of Global Competence in Engineering Education Based on Digital Technologies in Foreign Languages Studying
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article considers the problem of the implementation of digital interactive technologies in the process of foreign languages teaching as an important factor in increasing the effectiveness of engineering education in university. The concept of “global competence” is gaining popularity and importance in many areas of life, as well as in education. Knowledge of foreign languages is undoubtedly an important condition for the globalization of education. Digital interactive technologies contribute to the effective learning of foreign languages. The aim of this study is to review the most significant digital interactive technologies in foreign languages study. The study allows to plan specific steps to improve educational work at the university, which in turn contributes to the achievement of the main goal of education in the context of globalization - the preparation of competitive engineers.

articleTitle: Formation of Project and Research Competence of Students at Pedagogical Universities in the Sphere of Information Technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper focuses on the formation of project and research competence of students at pedagogical universities in the sphere of information technology. Some specific experience in working with undergraduates at different levels is presented through particular examples.

articleTitle: Features of the Use of E-learning in the Communicative Space of a Higher Educational Institution
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The era of globalization and digitalization brings many transformations to the communicative environment of higher education institutions, both positive and negative. New communication channels are emerging, prospects for interaction between the subjects of both global communication and the global educational process are being built, classical ways of obtaining scientific knowledge are being transformed. In this regard, there is a need for a new - modular - approach to the organization of the modern educational process, the organization of which is considered in detail by the authors.

articleTitle: Simulation Training as a Significant Factor in the Process of Preparing Dentists for Further Practical Activity
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: At the present stage of the development of dentistry, the most relevant is the ideology of training future dentists, which dictates the requirements for the creation of additional structural units directly involved in the process of training practical skills. Simulation training, which is becoming more widespread every year, is an educational process in which the student performs manipulations in an environment as close as possible to the real one, using special means-simulators and the necessary equipment. The analysis of simulation training based on the phantom center, which directly affects the level of mastering practical skills of students and residents of the Faculty of Dentistry, is carried out. High-quality simulation training requires not only phantoms, but also the most modern dental instruments, equipment and materials. Along with phantoms, the use of native drugs “preparation” and virtual training should be mandatory in the course of the simulation centers, which will maximize the list of skills being practiced. It is in the conditions of a specially equipped center, and not a department, that the content of training can be directed not only to the development of individual skills, but also to interdisciplinary training, teamwork, development of norms of professional behavior, communication with patients. However, such training should in no way replace any of the stages of training in Russian universities, but only complement real clinical practice, contributing to improving the quality of mastering practical skills.

articleTitle: Intelligent Laboratory of Relay Protection and Automation as a University-based Training Complex
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article considers the possibility of creating an intelligent digital laboratory of relay protection and automation on the basis of the university. Descriptive characteristic of microprocessor blocks is given. Functional capabilities of each individual unit are analyzed, as well as their interconnected operation. The arguments in favor of introducing a digital laboratory in the educational process are given. The necessary structural diagram, which visually displays the model of digital laboratory of intelligent relay protection and automation with the elements of digital substation is presented.

articleTitle: Telecommunication Distance Education Systems: New Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: the main issues of creation and operation of the telecommunications regional network of the Russian State University for the Humanities are considered. The main components of the system that ensure the planning, management and functioning of a higher educational institution in modern conditions are highlighted. The functions of the system, its information and technical support based on the use of the Internet and satellite channels are determined. The directions of modernization of the considered telecommunications regional system are proposed, ensuring its development and effective use in emergencies: sanctions, pandemics, etc.

Author Keywords: Russian State University for the Humanities

articleTitle: Gamification of the Educational Process. The Use of Decision Trees to Analyze the Influence of Computer Game Genres on the Preference of School Subjects
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: One of the tasks of today’s school education is to modernize the educational process by introducing teaching methods that increase its attractiveness. One of these methods is gamification, that is, the use of game forms of education to increase the effectiveness of the educational process. On the basis of a lot of data about attitude to educational subjects and interest in computer games, we have determined how attitude to the school subject and passion for a particular games genre are connected to increase raining efficiency. We created a questionnaire to conduct a survey on the preferences of subjects and attitudes to different genres of computer games, which we posted in Google Docs, as well as prepared a QR code to access the questionnaire; collected descriptive statistics for completed questionnaires; built decision trees using R language functions, showing the dependence of preferences to different school subjects on gender and age characteristics and attitudes to different genres of computer games.

articleTitle: Pupils’ First Interaction with GeoGebra on Learning Surface Area of Cuboid
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: GeoGebra-based mathematics instruction is an approach to teach mathematics that can support students to think mathematically. Learning using GeoGebra provides students with a new hands-on experience in learning mathematics as they can understand the mathematical concepts both from visualization and representation. This study employed the method of designing GeoGebra-based mathematics learning on the surface area of cuboid. This study aimed to provide a varied and exciting learning experience, support students in thinking mathematically and give a chance to students to solve mathematical problems correctly and fluently. The design of learning activities for the surface area of cuboid with GeoGebra was tested with 5 elementary school students. The results indicated that students began to understand surface area of cuboid logically, although some were still doubt to answer the accompanying questions.

articleTitle: Designing an Additional Professional Program of Psychological and Pedagogical Assistance to Families with Young Children on the Basis of a Digital Information and Educational Resource
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article presents conceptual approaches to the design of an additional professional program “Psychological and pedagogical assistance to families with young children” on the basis of a digital information and educational resource of the I. S. Turgenev Oryol State University. Special attention is paid to the substantiation of the list of professional competencies necessary for the implementation of psychological and pedagogical assistance to families with young children.

Author Keywords: psychological and pedagogical support of the family

articleTitle: Of the Use of Case Studies in Distance Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Due to the introduction of restrictive measures caused by the coronavirus pandemic, many universities were forced to switch to a distance learning format. The article analyzes the use of cases in distance learning methods. The main requirements for the case with this approach are defined. The advantages and disadvantages of case-based learning are determined. The author's algorithm of case-learning, which consists of several stages, is presented.

articleTitle: On the Issue of Creating an Course on Digital Educational Resources and Services for Organizing the Educational Process
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The large-scale processes of transition to the use of new information technologies in all spheres of society, which are currently taking place, make the issue of digital transformation of education relevant and significant as the most important means for solving the problem of digital transformation of the economy. Building a digital educational environment is one of the main strategic directions of the state policy of the Russian Federation. This construction implies the modernization of educational programs, updating the content, methods and organizational forms of educational activities, taking into account the digitalization of education, the creation and development of public platforms for online learning, the design of modern digital educational resources, including online courses. As the past year has shown, in a pandemic, the task of creating mixed courses is especially important. One of the problems is the teacher’s inability to systematically use digital educational resources, lack of understanding of the basics of managing the educational process based on the capabilities provided by educational platforms using online and mixed courses. The article presents course for the preparation of masters, which will try to solve the problem of preparing a modern teacher competent in the field of digital technologies, as well as the systematic use of the possibilities of managing the educational process online based on a blended learning model.

articleTitle: The Online Courses in the System of Training and Further Training of the Teaching Staff in the Context of the Digitalization of the General Education
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the issues of the modernization of the further training system of the teaching staff in the context of the digitalization of the general education. There is presented the theoretical and pedagogical analysis of the innovative technology’s potential of the organization of the distance education in the form of the online courses as the educational resource, aimed at the teachers’ further training. The authors demonstrate the characteristics of the online courses and specify the definition of the concept “online course”. There is described the classification of the educational online courses. The authors consider the methodological aspects of training the experts of Basic State Examination of Physics on the basis of the implementation of the online course.

articleTitle: The Study of Algorithms and Models for Clustering Data Arrays Based on the Collection and Analysis of a Lagre Corpus of Texts
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article uses the method of obtaining practical skills by students on the basis of algorithms and clustering models based on the analysis of the text corpus.

articleTitle: Methodological Aspects of Propaedeutics of Studying Artificial Intelligence by Medical Students
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The necessity of mastering the basics of artificial intelligence for specialists in various fields today is beyond doubt. The article substantiates the importance of propaedeutic acquaintance with the achievements in the field of activity chosen by students, in particular, in medicine. The methodological features and approximate content of such a lesson are considered, it is emphasized that students have the necessary knowledge base for the successful assimilation of the material.

articleTitle: Formation of Students’ Practical Skills in the Conditions of Distance Learning on the Basis of a Personalised Approach (Biotechnical Systems and Technologies, Master Studies)
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Today, the world is experiencing rapid progress in the development of biomedical devices and technologies. Therefore, medical universities face the need for serious training of competent specialists who are able to set up complex and innovative medical equipment. In order to curb the latest technologies and learn how to properly operate devices, it is necessary to train specialised personnel whose specific work is interaction with high-tech medical devices. For this task, such a direction as “Biotechnical systems and technologies” was formed, combining an engineering specialty on the basis of the Volgograd State Medical University. A theoretical review of the problem of personalised learning in domestic and foreign, mainly American pedagogical science is given. The article deals with the issue of the formation of practical skills of master's students in the context of distance education based on a personalised approach to learning. The data of a survey of students of the studied specialty are given.

articleTitle: Social Risks of Digitalization of Education
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discusses the social consequences of digitalization in education, focuses on the possible risks of this process. Defining the digitalization of education as an objective consequence of the technical process, the authors draw attention to such negative consequences as the loss of basic cognitive competencies, a decrease in the overall level of training of both students in the system of school and vocational education. The consequence of digitalization is atomization both in the interpersonal interaction of students and in their communication with teachers. Digitalization is one of the mechanisms for the reproduction of social inequality in society, because is aimed at the standardization of thinking, the reproduction of “ready-made knowledge”, and not at the development of creative thinking. Formally equal diplomas do not eliminate differences in the level of training and competencies of specialists from elite and non-elite educational institutions. In the latter, students act as objects, and not as equal subjects of the educational process, and one of the reasons for this is the use of technologies without the human factor to control students’ knowledge, distance learning, minimizing contacts between teachers and students. Understanding the digitalization of education as an objective and contradictory process, the authors of the article actualize the task of preventing a number of its negative consequences.

articleTitle: Incorporating Analysis of Finite Fluctuations in Major Applied Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present innovative scientific direction for higher education in the “Applied Mathematics” direction of training - analysis of finite fluctuations (AFF). AFF is a complex of methods including direct algebraic method and different representations of mean value theorems such as Lagrange and Bonnet. As an example of the practical application an organizational system such as the university rating system is studied. It is proposed to consider the application of AFF to innovative processes in education as a new task of pedagogical innovation.

articleTitle: Philosophical Aspects of Distance Education
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper deals with the specifics of distance education from a socio-philosophical position, it considers its advantages and disadvantages, both from the point of view of education and from the standpoint of personality formation. Distance education should be considered not as a way of learning using modern technical means and network learning technologies, but as a factor of systemic thinking, of formation of new education culture and as a result of a new type of personality that satisfies the needs of modern society. The paper also discusses the trends in education in the near future in the context of the rapid development of the information society.

articleTitle: Methodology for the Study of Meteorological Information Distribution between Regions
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In this work a network is studied, the nodes being the regions between which it is necessary to distribute meteorological information coming from its source. The subject of the study is weather stations (the main components of the network) and meteorological information produced by them. Any weather stations are complex techno-economic systems, which are conjoined by the need to supply them with the main resource for the meteorological information production and the need for its distribution. The authors developed a model of the meteorological information distribution between the regions with certain conditions based on the model of obtaining, distributing and transmitting meteorological information in a general form. Using the model, based on the initial data, it is possible to decide how to distribute the produced meteorological information between the regions so as to maximize the profit of weather stations. The described model includes a sub-task solution. The purpose of the model study is to maximize profit based on the initial data.

articleTitle: High-Precision Approximation of the Acceleration Curve to Obtain the Transfer Function at the «Thermal Object» Training Stand
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The method of obtaining the transient response at the training stand «Thermal object» and its subsequent high-precision approximation by the Simoyu area method in the Jupyter environment in the Python programming language is considered. The proposed programming algorithm makes it possible to obtain the transfer function with the lowest average relative error of approximation, which will provide a high control accuracy.

articleTitle: The Concept of Creating an Institute of Tutoring in The System of Higher Education Through the Introduction of Interdisciplinary Modular Educational Technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article describes the concept of creating a tutoring institution in the system of higher education through the introduction of interdisciplinary modular educational technologies. The main directions of creating a tutoring institute are revealed: theoretical and methodological, legal, organizational substantiation of the concept of creating a tutoring institute in the higher education system through the introduction of interdisciplinary modular educational technologies, development of a model for creating a tutoring institute in the higher education system through the introduction of interdisciplinary modular educational technologies.

articleTitle: On One Method for Assessing the Compulsory and Progress of Education among Preschoolers and Primary Schoolchildren in the Framework of Additional Education in the Study of Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article discusses a method for assessing the knowledge of children of preschool and primary school age using mathematics as an example. This method allows diagnosing problems in children in the sections of the curriculum, which was compiled by a teacher of additional education for the academic year. This method characterizes each child individually, which allows teachers or parents to correct the map of his development as part of the development of the discipline.

articleTitle: The Concept of Creating a Software Digital Twin of an Electronic Device
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The concept of creating a software digital twin of electronic devices is considered. This digital twin can be used as the basis of virtual simulators that are part of electronic teaching and training aids in the field of operation of high-tech products (electronic devices). Definitions, goals, problems of the electronic device digital twin are given. Also, digital twin structure and a variant of its implementation using web technologies are introduced.

articleTitle: The Online Course of School Students’ Training to Basic State Examination of Computer Studies as a Means of the Implementation of the Educational Activity in the Students’ Online Communities
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with a number of issues of teaching school students in online communities. There is specified the definition of online communities, there is considered the classification of online communities. The authors describe the theoretical approaches to the development of the online course of Computer Studies in the context of the implementation of the Federal State Educational Standards and the digital transformation of education on the basis of the online course “Training school students to Basic State Examination of Computer Studies” implemented in Volgograd State Socio-Pedagogical University”.

articleTitle: Improving Engineering Creativity in the Context of Digital Transformation of Construction Education
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discusses the possibility of creating a digital environment for engineering creativity for organizing training for students of construction universities on the basis of cloud technologies, which is an urgent task in the context of the implementation of the state program “Digital Economy of the Russian Federation”. The purpose of the study is to develop theoretical foundations for creating a cloud-based digital environment for engineering creativity for the interaction of participants in the creative process in construction universities. The practical value of the study lies in the possibility of using the proposed solution in the implementation of distance learning for students of construction universities.

Author Keywords: cloud digital environment of engineering creativity

articleTitle: Interdisciplinary and Multidisciplinary Learning: Applied Mathematics Major in Lipetsk State Technical University
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The implementation of interdisciplinary and multidisciplinary training in the field of “Applied Mathematics” at the Lipetsk State Technical University is illustrated by the example of interconnected teaching of a number of basic disciplines of undergraduate and graduate programs devoted to mathematical modeling and control.

articleTitle: Project-Based Learning Exemplified by Research and Development of Polymer Membrane Roof Shells
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Lack of the competent specialists acts as a brake on the progress in the building industry. Project-based learning is used for developing the following professional skills of engineering students: identifying the challenges and deep understanding the problem, considering the entire project and choosing appropriate ways for tackling it, performing numerical simulation and laboratory mockups of the constructions. The learning strategy is exemplified by research and development of polymer membrane roofs. The membrane roofs are sensitive to proper design and implementation. The process of designing the membrane must be taken in its entirety. It can not be considered as a set of independent activities. Two types of the membrane roofs are considered and analyzed. Detection of the intrinsic problems of the constructions is illustrated. Membrane edges and corners are numerically simulated. The ways for improving them are discussed. The membrane pre-stressing technique is considered and experimental mockups are proposed for further research.

articleTitle: Using the Arduino Platform to Organize Project Activities in Technoparks
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper discusses the possibilities of using the Arduino microprocessor platform in educational institutions for the organization of project activities. The main functions, properties and capabilities of the Arduino platform are described. The directions of using microprocessor platforms in educational technoparks are determined. Examples of projects implemented on the basis of Arduino in the VGSPU technopark are given.

Author Keywords: project activity of schoolchildren and students.

articleTitle: The Filters for Websites by Organizing Distance Learning Processes
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper provides a systematic analysis of the task to minimize the risks of aggressive influences in social networks and educational structures. The article analyz-es the goals and objectives of countering sites with un-desirable (low-quality) content on students or school-children when organizing independent work. The classes of aggressive sites and their impact are analyzed. Recog-nition of aggressive and “Trojan” content or resource for learning purposes is a multifaceted problem, often with uncertainties and “white” noise. This work proposes ap-proaches to counteract this noise. The analysis is valua-ble to develop measures and approaches to filtering ag-gressive sites. A model for evaluating the aggressive ca-pabilities of the site is also considered.

articleTitle: Model of Organizing Online Learning for Students in Agricultural Area
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Currently, Uzbekistan is rapidly implementing measures to develop digital technologies in all spheres of the economy, as well as to widely introduce information and communication technologies in public administration, education, healthcare and agriculture and other areas of public life. The country needs specialists with systems thinking, who can make informed decisions, who are able to think outside the box and modern, who are able to search for and use useful information, and learn innovative technologies. Internet technologies play an important role in solving these problems in the educational system. In particular, the implementation of priority projects has begun, which provide for the improvement of the e-government system, the development of the market for software products and information technologies, the organization of IT parks in all regions of the republic, and the provision of this area with qualified personnel. The article presents a model for organizing students’ independent work using online technologies. Detailed instructions are given for completing a specific task in computer science using an electronic educational resource developed by the authors of this article

Author Keywords: means of information and telecommunication technologies

articleTitle: Current Aspects of Training Digital Consultants in Online Communities of Schoolchildren
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with a number of issues of training the digital consultants in the online communities of the schoolchildren. Specifically, there are described the modules of the training program, there is substantiated the efficiency of the collaborative educational activity in the training process in the context of the online communities of the students of the higher forms based on the integration of the Learning Management System (LMS) and the social services of the Internet.

articleTitle: Forecast of Economic Development in Russia 2022-2035
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article describes the technology of making a long-term forecast of the development of the Russian economy, the need for which arose in connection with the large-scale sanctions of the West. To make a new forecast for 2022-2035, it is proposed to use the P1-4-2(2022-3) model, which converts the initial data scenario corresponding to sanctions into a forecast. The scenario is expert assessments of changes in exports and imports, as well as the ruble exchange rate and oil prices. The forecast is a sequence of solutions of systems of linear equations, the coefficients of which depend on the scenario. This article has practical and methodological application in the educational field in the field of economics. Obtaining these graphs and conclusions from them help students to visually navigate the economic situation in the country, as well as to make a forecast based on the obtained graphs.

Author Keywords: estimates of GDP and inflation by World Bank experts
model of reproduction of Russia’s GDP

articleTitle: Some Applications of the Training Programs on the Transport Task
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Training programs can play an important role in the learning process. They provide support for the learning process on a par with traditional teaching aids. The article discusses training programs for solving transport tasks by the cost criterion and by the time criterion. The possibilities of programs for independent work of students and carrying out control activities are described. The results of the statistical analysis of the using the training program to prepare for the performance of the control task are presented.

articleTitle: Criteria for Assessing Media Literacy and Media Competence
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The concepts of “media literacy” and “media competence” are determined, scientifically substantiated and criteria and indicators for their evaluation are developed. Due to the fact that the media and communications are in constant transformation, the directions and models for the development of media education are identified.

articleTitle: Compliance with Human Rights on the Example Of Obtaining Grants in the Field of Smart Technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article contains a legal description of the concepts of freedom of human rights, some problems of grantees are disclosed. The legal conflict associated with the receipt of grants by educational organizations is revealed. On the example of obtaining a grant in the field of smart technologies from the Innovation Promotion Fund, the solution to this conflict is considered

articleTitle: Distance Learning During the Pandemic. Organizational and Managerial Problems
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The pandemic has changed the world, and the education system has changed too. Previously, distance education was limited to mainly episodic experiments in its application using traditional paper textbooks and materials. Now, distance education based on digital communication technologies and a digital form of presentation of the educational content became the only possible one. If earlier such a form of learning was inherent rather in the levels of additional and professional education, then the pandemic has made it the only possible format for all levels of education. Naturally, the implementation of such education largely depended on the existence of basic digital competencies among teachers and students, on the availability of access to such education at their place of residence and on the experience of creating and implementing the content of education in the format of digital educational resources, video lectures, seminars with use of educational platforms and others. After several semesters of such training, it is already possible to talk about the first experience of mass distance learning. And when using it henceforth as an independent learning format or a component of blended learning, it is necessary to understand the attitude of all participants in the educational process towards it, their readiness for such a format of activity and its acceptance as a real alternative to traditional learning. Now we can say that in its pure form, in the format of distance learning only, professional education is practically not feasible. It requires meaningful practical content, not only knowledge, but also skills and abilities. And they are not formed outside of specialized laboratories and regular communications in the professional community in the process of teamwork.

Author Keywords: digital competencies of participants in educational activities
educational space outside of the educational organization

articleTitle: Interdisciplinary Learning Experience: Dental Disease Prevention Program for Diabetes Mellitus
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article reflects the relevance of making educational programs for students and physicians using interdisciplinary approach. Authors demonstrate experience of interdisciplinary integration between the staff of the Department for Propaedeutics of Dental Diseases of the Volgograd State Medical University and the Department for Internal Medicine of the Institute of Continuous Medical and Pharmaceutical Education of the Volgograd State Medical University. The connection between diabetes mellitus and dental diseases (periodontal and oral mucosa diseases, caries and other dental pathology) was considered. An algorithm was given for carrying out the prevention and dental treatment for diabetic patients. Also, authors demonstrate that The inclusion of a program for the dental disease prevention for diabetes patients into the educational process.

articleTitle: The Use of Digital Resources as a Means of Forming a Foreign Language Communicative Competence of University Students (on the Example of Teaching Special Vocabulary)
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The study discusses the effectiveness of applying the model of teaching special vocabulary to students of higher educational institutions through digital resources. An indicator of the effectiveness of teaching a foreign language is the formation of foreign language communicative competence among students. The relevance of the research problem is determined by the need to find effective ways of teaching professional vocabulary in a foreign language to students of higher educational institutions. The model of teaching special vocabulary using digital resources, proposed by the authors, for students of the undergraduate program 29.03.04 “Decorative material working techniques” in the context of studying the discipline “Foreign language” has been tested.

articleTitle: Digitalization in Education and Learning Activities
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: To analyze the essence of digital transformation and the ways in which it becomes possible. This article focuses on students’ reactions, their assessments and views on ongoing online learning. The main research questions posed in the article are: is ongoing digital learning effective? Do students evaluate what happened as a digital transformation in education? What are the main challenges facing ongoing digital learning?

articleTitle: Incorporating Digital Competences in Social Sciences and Humanities Subjects Curricula: a Course Design Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Development of competences demanded in the technologically rich environment has become a challenging task for universities. This task should not be regarded as an information technology disciplines’ prerogative. On the contrary, developers of curriculum documentation and teaching materials should adhere to the interdisciplinary approach to course design. A review of publications on digital competence conceptions allowed the authors to highlight digital skills and abilities that are in immediate connection with key social, communicative, cognitive competences and competences for lifelong learning. The principles that enable teachers to achieve efficient integration of digital competences in a non-technical subject curriculum are formulated in the article. These principles are accompanied by step-by-step guidelines that will help update teaching programmes and materials. The examples presented in the article illustrate how course objectives, teaching techniques, and assessment criteria are reconsidered in line with digital transformation of higher education.

articleTitle: Identification of Students’ Professional Competence Based on Big Data and Digital Footprints Based on Big Data Analytics and E-proctoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In the age of the digital society formation in countries of the post-industrial development stage, digital transformations take place in all spheres of public life. Such social institution as education witnesses especially drastic changes. New learning formats are emerging, including Online learning, E-learning, Smart-learning, Smart Education and other distance learning forms. However, during the COVID-19 pandemic, the scientific and educational community updated a number of issues regarding the identification of works, assessing the level of comprehensibility of the discipline and the independence of completing individual tasks of distance learning students. The present research is intended to complement the range of relevant studies in this area as it is devoted to the methodology of Big Data Analytics and e-proctoring at higher education institutions. The results of this study will help to improve the understanding of the algorithm for the final certification of students. In addition, the subjects of the educational process will be able to improve their skills in solving the problems of conducting final and intermediate certification in the format of distance learning and optimize this process in educational institutions of various levels.

articleTitle: International Experience of Digital Technologies Applying in Secondary Education Organizations Activities
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper presents materials on the analysis of international experience in the use of digital technologies in the activities of educational institutions in foreign countries with high quality education: analysis of international experience in the use of digital technologies in the management of educational institutions of general education in Australia, Singapore, Sweden; analysis of the main features of the use of digital technologies in the activities of educational institutions of general education in France; comparative analysis of the problems of digital transformation of secondary education in Russia and abroad (the experience of the USA and Western Europe); analysis of the experience of using virtual, augmented, mixed, augmented reality technologies in the activities of educational organizations of foreign countries with high quality education; comparative analysis of international experience in the implementation of organizational and methodological conditions to ensure information security of the personality of subjects of the educational process in the activities of educational institutions in foreign countries with high quality education; analysis of international experience in the implementation of health-preserving approaches to organizing the learning process using digital technologies in educational institutions of foreign countries with high quality education.

articleTitle: Quality Estimation of Electronic Educational Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The transition of modern higher education to online learning is analyzed, the relevance of estimation the quality of electronic educational resources is substantiated. Using the Ishikawa diagram, problems were identified in estimation the quality of electronic educational resources. Criteria and procedure for estimation the quality of electronic educational resources were proposed, modeling of the process of estimation the quality of electronic educational resources was carried out. The requirements for conducting an expert estimation of the quality of electronic educational resources, for a user estimation of the quality of electronic educational resources have been determined. Quality estimation of electronic educational resources in the area of training "Quality Management" was carried out.

articleTitle: University Digital Document Management and Optimal Strategy of Education Data Warehouses’ Placement
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The development of the information society supposes introduction of more and more intelligent and optimal methods for realizing a wide variety of activities; and the education sector occupies one of the first places in the list of priorities. There are several reasons: this is the extreme variety of various business processes at the university, and a special contingent of users who are able to perceive the latest trends and methods of working with information, and even require their prompt implementation. Finally, the use of a highly intelligent product by students also plays an educational role.
