The article proposes and discusses ways to improve the information systems through using computer science methods, based on the application of graph theory. This is, firstly, the task of designing a university document management system that optimizes documentary support for business processes by reducing number of document units without changing functionality of the processes. For this task, the use of methods of the Kruskal type is proposed. Secondly, the problem of optimal placement of information resources in a local network configuration is considered, which is focused on finding the minimum cost flows in the network model. The paper shows that algorithms, based on the Hitchcock method, can be recommended for this purpose.

articleTitle: Analysis of Educational Content on the Websites of Political Parties
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of the educational content of the websites of political parties of the Lipetsk region. The article makes a theoretical analysis of the main categories: political socialization, stages of political socialization, political parties, types and functions of political parties. The analysis of the content of the websites of political parties of the Lipetsk region for the presence of educational, educational and informational aspects that contribute to political socialization and political self-determination of young people is carried out. Based on the analysis of the content of the websites of political parties in the Lipetsk region, the problem is revealed: insufficient content of the websites of political parties, which would contribute to political socialization and political self-determination of young people. Based on the identified problem, it is proposed to create an integrated educational platform that helps young people with political self-determination, and aimed at increasing the involvement of young people in the political life of the region.

articleTitle: Recommendations for France Educational Institutions Digital Technologies Using in Native Distance Education
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper provides an overview of the France educational system digital technologies experience using in context of the hybrid education implementation, as a country with high quality of education. On the generalized analysis basis recommendations and proposals for native education on the educational process realization with the use of distance learning technologies experience implementation are presented.

Author Keywords: digital educational technologies applying skills acquirement

articleTitle: Methodological Training of Future Teachers of Computer Science to Carry Out Their Activities in a Remote Form on the Basis of New Models
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Methodological training of future teachers of computer science to carry out their activities in a remote form involves the implementation of new models of organization and implementation of the educational process. The article presents scientifically-based proposals for the implementation by future teachers of two models of teaching students computer science. The first model involves the use of digital devices of students and the Internet and direct full or partial interaction with the teacher. The second model is based on the predominant independent work of students. For each model, examples of the presentation of educational content using modern technologies, cloud services, and other communication tools are defined. On the basis of the Department of Computer Science and Methods of Teaching Computer Science of BSPU, the testing of these models was carried out for the implementation of methodological training of future teachers of computer science. The developed recommendations make it easy to implement the process of pre-paring educational content for students on all topics of the subject “Computer Science”.

articleTitle: The Technology for Evaluation of Future Russian Teacher’s Readiness for Professional Activity
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of formation of readiness for professional activity among students of pedagogical universities, as well as the question of how and by what means should determine the availability of this readiness. Based on the analysis of studies of the concept of “readiness for professional activity of graduates of pedagogical higher education institution”, in accordance with the requirements of the Professional standard of teachers it is shown that the readiness for professional activity of teachers of the graduate of pedagogical higher school must be considered as an integrative quality of the subject of this activity, including the motivation for the teaching profession and the self-improvement of personality of a teacher. To assess readiness, a dichotomic approach is proposed: the graduate is either ready for professional activity or not ready. As a tool for assessing readiness, it is proposed to form an electronic student portfolio, in which during the years of study at the University there is a fixation and accumulation of information about individual achievements of students, external and reflective assessments of the results of their activities from the position of their own advancement to the established educational goal.

Author Keywords: readiness for the teacher’s professional activity
portfolio as a way of forming and evaluating readiness
advantages of portfolio technology in vocational training
